facts.value: 1 × DMX output (female XLR5), 1 × DMX input (male XLR5), 1 × USB 2.0 Type-B
DMX input or DMX output mode
5 V DC via USB, 300 mA, 1.5 W
1500 V full isolation for both data and power lines
USITT DMX512-A, ANSI E1.20 RDM (if supported by your third-party software)
Windows, Mac and Linux (Raspberry Pi too)

facts.note: https://cdn.enttec.com/pdf/assets/70304/70304_DMX_USB_PRO_API.pdf, linked from the product page; not read here.

setup.en: From a page with no bridge: dmxTransport('serial', { patch, universe: 1 }) and a Connect button that calls connect(); the browser asks which port only from a click. Chrome or Edge on a computer, on https or localhost.
setup.zh: 不經橋接程式、直接從網頁：dmxTransport('serial', { patch, universe: 1 })，加一個呼叫 connect() 的 Connect 按鈕，瀏覽器只會在點擊時問要用哪個連接埠。電腦上的 Chrome 或 Edge，https 或 localhost。

setup.en: Through the out-bridge instead: an enttec route with the serial device's path, { "match": "dmx/1/*", "sink": "enttec", "path": "/dev/cu.usbserial-…", "universe": 1 }. A missing device is a status, retried every 2 s.
setup.zh: 改經輸出橋接程式：一條帶序列裝置路徑的 enttec 路由，{ "match": "dmx/1/*", "sink": "enttec", "path": "/dev/cu.usbserial-…", "universe": 1 }。裝置不在時是一個狀態，每 2 秒重試。

problems.en: On Web Serial there is no watchdog: the Pro keeps repeating the last frame, so send a blackout before close().
problems.zh: 用 Web Serial 時沒有看門狗：Pro 會一直重送最後一格，所以 close() 之前先送 blackout。

problems.en: OAV writes the Pro's "send DMX" frames but no RDM; and an Enttec Open DMX or a bare FTDI cable is not this device and does not work with it.
problems.zh: OAV 寫的是 Pro 的「送出 DMX」訊框，沒有 RDM。Enttec Open DMX 或單純的 FTDI 線不是這台，不能這樣用。

use.call: const out = dmxTransport('serial', { patch, universe: 1 }); button.onclick = () => out.connect()
use.en: The page writes whole Enttec frames by Web Serial, at most one every 25 ms while anything changes and once a second otherwise, through the flash guard.
use.zh: 網頁經 Web Serial 寫入完整的 Enttec 訊框，有變化時最快每 25 毫秒一格，沒變化時每秒一格，都先經過頻閃保護。

use.call: dmxTransport('bridge', { patch, client: new OutClient({ url: 'ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out' }).connect() })
use.en: The out-bridge's enttec sink carries one universe to the Pro on a serial device, with the watchdog's safe values when the page goes away.
use.zh: 輸出橋接程式的 enttec sink 把一個 universe 送到序列裝置上的 Pro，網頁離開時由看門狗送安全值。

tbd.en: No real DMX USB Pro has received OAV's frames yet: the bytes follow the published API and the tests decode them on a stand-in port.
tbd.zh: 還沒有一台真的 DMX USB Pro 收過 OAV 的訊框：位元組照公開的 API 寫，測試在替身連接埠上解碼。
